import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SeparatingMap
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.IntermediateField.Adjoin.Basic

/-!
# The field image of a projective-line chart

The local ring map induced by a point of the standard affine chart has image
the intermediate field generated by its chart value. Consequently, the same
field is the image of the generic stalk pullback of a morphism realizing that
value. No choice of coordinate value is made here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

private theorem range_localization_eq_adjoin
    {k K A S : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing S] [Algebra A S]
    (M : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization M S]
    (e : A ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial k) (t : K) (f : S →+* K) [IsLocalHom f]
    (hf : ∀ a, f (algebraMap A S a) = Polynomial.aeval t (e a)) :
    Set.range f = (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t} : Set K) := by
  ext x
  change x ∈ Set.range f ↔ x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k {t}
  rw [IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M z
    have hb : f (algebraMap A S b) ≠ 0 :=
      ((IsLocalization.map_units S b).map f).ne_zero
    refine ⟨e a, e b, (eq_div_iff (by simpa [hf] using hb)).mpr ?_⟩
    simpa only [map_mul, hf] using congrArg f h
  · rintro ⟨p, q, rfl⟩
    by_cases hq : Polynomial.aeval t q = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [hq]⟩
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap A S (e.symm q)) := by
      apply (isUnit_map_iff f _).mp
      rw [hf, e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact IsUnit.mk0 _ hq
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨algebraMap A S (e.symm p) * (↑v⁻¹ : S), ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, map_units_inv, hv, hf, hf, e.apply_symm_apply, e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm

private theorem toStalk_stalkClosedPointTo_specMap
    {A K : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsLocalRing K] (f : A ⟶ K) (a : A) :
    (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (Spec.map f)).hom
        ((StructureSheaf.toStalk A
          ((Spec.map f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K))).hom a) = f.hom a := by
  change ((StructureSheaf.toStalk A _) ≫ (Spec.map f).stalkMap _ ≫
    (stalkClosedPointIso K).hom).hom a = f.hom a
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  erw [stalkMap_toStalk]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← stalkClosedPointIso_inv, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

private theorem range_comp_of_isIso
    {A B C : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) [IsIso f] :
    Set.range (f ≫ g).hom = Set.range g.hom := by
  change Set.range (g.hom ∘ f.hom) = _
  have hs := ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective f).mp inferInstance).2
  rw [Set.range_comp, hs.range_eq]
  simp

private theorem range_stalkClosedPointTo_comp_of_isOpenImmersion
    {K : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsLocalRing K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Spec K ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    Set.range (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (f ≫ g)).hom =
      Set.range (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo f).hom := by
  rw [Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_comp]
  exact range_comp_of_isIso _ _

/-- The local ring map of a point of the standard chart has image the field
generated by the chart value. This applies to both algebraic and
transcendental chart values. -/
theorem range_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecChart
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : K) :
    Set.range (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (P1.fromSpecChart k (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) 0 t)).hom =
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t} : Set K) := by
  unfold P1.fromSpecChart
  rw [range_stalkClosedPointTo_comp_of_isOpenImmersion]
  let A := HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)
    (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2))
  let φ : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of K :=
    P1.chartEval k (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) 0 t
  let p : PrimeSpectrum A := (Spec.map φ) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)
  let S := (Spec.structureSheaf A).presheaf.stalk p
  let f : S →+* K := (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (Spec.map φ)).hom
  letI : IsLocalHom f :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (Spec.map φ)).hom)
  have hf : ∀ a, f (algebraMap A S a) =
      Polynomial.aeval t ((P1.awayAlgEquiv k (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)) a) := by
    intro a
    change (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (Spec.map φ)).hom
      ((StructureSheaf.toStalk A p).hom a) = _
    rw [toStalk_stalkClosedPointTo_specMap]
    rfl
  exact range_localization_eq_adjoin p.asIdeal.primeCompl
    (P1.awayAlgEquiv k (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)) t f hf

private theorem range_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk_comp
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    Set.range (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ f)).hom =
      Set.range (f.stalkMap x).hom := by
  rw [Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_comp, Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk,
    f.stalkMap_congr_point _ x Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]
  exact range_comp_of_isIso _ _

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra

/-- If a morphism to `P1` realizes the rational function `t` on the generic
chart, the image of its actual generic stalk map is precisely `k(t)`. -/
theorem range_generic_stalkMap_toP1_eq_adjoin
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    (t : X.left.functionField) (π : X.left ⟶ P1 k)
    (hgen : X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ π =
      P1.fromSpecChart k (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)) 0 t) :
    Set.range (π.stalkMap (genericPoint X.left)).hom =
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t} : Set X.left.functionField) := by
  have hscalar : X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k X.left.functionField) := by
    ext r
    change (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)).hom r =
      functionFieldOverAlgebraMap k X.left r
    simp [Scheme.Hom.structureStalk, functionFieldOverAlgebraMap,
      Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
  rw [← range_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk_comp π (genericPoint X.left), hgen,
    hscalar]
  exact range_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecChart t

/-! The preceding image computation is the missing field-theoretic bridge in the
finite-map residue route: the finite separable extension supplied by a
separating function is the extension seen by the actual generic stalk map. -/

theorem exists_separating_function_with_generic_stalk_image
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    [IsProper X.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ (t : X.left.functionField) (π : X.left ⟶ P1 k),
      Transcendental k t ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t}) X.left.functionField ∧
      Module.Finite (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t}) X.left.functionField ∧
      IsFinite π ∧ IsDominant π ∧ π ≫ P1.structureMap k = X.hom ∧
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ π =
        P1.fromSpecChart k (X.hom.structureStalk (genericPoint X.left)) 0 t ∧
      Set.range (π.stalkMap (genericPoint X.left)).hom =
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {t} : Set X.left.functionField) := by
  obtain ⟨t, π, ht, hsep, hfin, hπfin, hπdom, hπover, hπgen⟩ :=
    exists_isFinite_toP1_with_separating_function X
  refine ⟨t, π, ht, hsep, hfin, hπfin, hπdom, hπover, hπgen, ?_⟩
  exact range_generic_stalkMap_toP1_eq_adjoin X t π hπgen

end
end Hartshorne
